raw_checks: Local kill/restart, SQLite busy release, deleted-source cases: retained actual RPC, owned PID/exit/cleanup and source-span hits; no false ready/deleted resurrection.

For each active seed: actual loopback HTTP disconnect retains retryable pending outbox/backfilling/partial state; local fallback adds no provider calls; authored subsequent source recovers without edited retry clocks.
Each active seed corrupts a real artifact payload then restores original bytes; semantic lane goes partial/incomplete then complete with request counts preserved.
Each active seed changes actual format_version to 999 then restores original metadata; reader rejects unsupported format, original lane recovers.

Each active seed physically holds old-incarnation worker, performs replacement, verifies incarnation change, no false ready/stale publication/deleted manifest; persisted SQLite integrity/FK checks and reopen.
Read production fault stdout and retained Rust executable/Cargo event for every selected test; do not count a filtered/ignored/nonexecuted test as success.
P7 active stdout: original raw bytes retained, stdout_reader_joined=true, no normal-exit stdout_errors or unmatched response; deliberate SIGKILL may interrupt stdout under the declared case only.
Use observed_provider_requests/provider_calls/recovery request deltas to explain cost impact. paid_cost/actual_paid_cost stays null for fake loopback provider, not zero billed cost.

Any missing seed, fault test, observer identity, required retained raw, timeout, source drift or false-ready/deletion violation.
